title: Uhc_Untils
description: Lightweight UHC textures that enhance visibility, simplify items, and give you a sharper competitive edge.
body: ## 📖 Description **This UHC texture pack is designed for players who want clean visuals, smooth performance, and clear item textures during competitive matches. It removes unnecessary visual noise and focuses on clarity, helping you spot ores, mobs, and players faster. The pack keeps Minecraft’s original style while enhancing color balance, UI elements, and overall readability.** Features ## ✨ Key Features 🔍 **Clean & Simplified Textures** — Improves visual clarity while preserving Minecraft's original style. ⚔️ **PvP-Optimized Design** — Enhanced weapons, armor, and UI for a smoother competitive experience. ⛏️ **High-Visibility Ores** — Makes valuable ores easier to identify during mining and UHC matches. ⚡ **Lightweight & Performance-Friendly** — Optimized for smooth gameplay on both low-end and high-end devices. 🎯 **Built for Competitive Gameplay** — Perfect for UHC, PvP, BedWars, SkyWars, and other fast-paced game modes. ## 🧩 **Compatibility** ✅ Compatible with most modern Minecraft Java Edition versions. ✅ Fully supports both Vanilla Minecraft and OptiFine. ✅ Optimized for smooth performance on both low-end and high-end PCs.
